title: FAA UAP reports, batch 03 (237UAP00056 - 237UAP00080)
doc_notes: This document contains a series of FAA Skywatch incident reports regarding UAP sightings, including jetpacks, balloons, and radar targets.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a white, diamond-shaped object passing underneath.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported an unidentified aerial phenomenon pass underneath

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon from both sides.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported an unidentified aerial phenomenon from the left and right side

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon at same altitude.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was undescribed by the flight crew

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a jet pack.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported a Jet Pack LGB205004

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft struck a silver balloon.
incidents.quote: Aircraft struck an unidentified aerial phenomenon (balloon)

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a jet pack.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was a jet pack.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an object with star-shaped lighting that hovered.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon had star shaped lighting, rapidly changing altitudes then hovered.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported an unidentified aerial phenomenon off of left side

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a strobing object in a race track formation.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was strobing in a race track formation

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a person in a jet pack.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported person in a jet pack

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a jet pack with red and green lights.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was a jet pack with red and green lights.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an object that shot straight up from the ground.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon shot straight up from the ground past the plane.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon above them.
incidents.quote: The pilot was unable to describe the elements of the UFO.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft observed a manned jetpack.
incidents.quote: Aircraft observed a manned jetpack off the left side

incidents.summary: Primary target detected by radar near DAA, no visual verification.
incidents.location_name: Arlington Ridge Rd and Lynne St
incidents.quote: PCT reported a primary target near DAA moving north eastbound.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a jetpack individual.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported as a "jetpack individual"

incidents.summary: Residents and controller reported a green fireball.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was described as a large green fire ball

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an unidentified phenomenon.
incidents.quote: Aircraft reported an unidentified aerial phenomenon above them

incidents.summary: Primary target detected by radar moving southeast.
incidents.quote: PCT reported a primary target at the DCA0100027, southeast bound

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported an object resembling space debris.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported looking like space debris (burning flames)

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported airborne lights.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was reported as airborne lights traveling left to right.

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a jet pack man.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was described as a jet pack man

incidents.summary: Commercial aircraft reported a flash of light or space debris.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was described as a flash of light or space debris.

incidents.summary: General aviation aircraft reported a 25 ft diameter balloon.
incidents.quote: The unknown phenomenon was a balloon 25 ft in diameter.
